README

Amberstone

A local, real-time coaching companion for League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics.

About this artifact

This file is a self-contained, offline map of the Amberstone repository. Nodes are the project's components - modules, docs, tools, agents, and upstream services; the surrounding dust field is the rest of the source tree. Hover a node for its summary, click to focus; controls are listed along the bottom edge. Nothing here loads from the network.

The project in one paragraph

Amberstone watches a live game through the client's local data feed and the screen, then serves short, situation-specific advice - what to build, when to fight - to a local dashboard. A local math engine, Daemon Slayer, ranks items with real damage and durability numbers for the matchup at hand, and an AI coach turns those numbers into the on-screen advice; screen reading is OCR first, with an AI model as the escalation for what OCR misses. Everything runs on one PC. The live engine version and patch are stamped in the HUD readout, never here.

Where the real docs are

  • README.md - the project front page
  • docs/ARCHITECTURE.md - component map
  • docs/DAEMON_SLAYER.md - the build engine
  • ROADMAP.md - open work

These paths resolve next to a repository checkout; this file travels alone.
